what: The open approval cards of a chat are listed in its prompt (title as the agent must give it back); an answer ending in a block ```approval-done (alias ```freigabe-erledigt), one line per card the person decided in words, "No: " in front for a no, closes exactly those cards (POST /api/v1/agent/chats/{id}/messages/{mid}/withdraw, outcome withdrawn or denied), never as a yes; no hit or several hits: nothing is closed; 2.615.0 (#3658 / #2347, #3757 / #3752): the prompt lists each card with its number ("Card 1234: title"), a line "Card 1234: …" closes exactly that one (a stale number falls back to the words), identical duplicate cards are not ambiguous (each line closes one), else one card whose words match clearly better (>= 60 %, 20 points ahead of the next)
